summary: Ensemble aggregate is very low at 2%, implying a baseline belief that an early publication before April 10 is unlikely.
Adversarial objections describe plausible channels (early leaks, mid-April window flexibility, industry-driven push) that could yield an earlier reveal, although these are not strongly deterministic.
Historical pattern generally places the reveal in mid-April, after April 10, which argues against earlier publication but does not preclude it.
Overall, a modest upward calibration is justified to reflect non-negligible but still unlikely chances of an earlier reveal.
